name: Lex Graphite
description: Warm white paper with graphite-blue ink (softer than black) and a calm deep-teal accent. Noto Sans SC + Manrope, 16px rounded cards on double soft shadows. The lawyer sitting across the table from you, not across the courtroom — built for everyday Q&A and plain-language explainers.

bestFor: 日常法律答疑 / 粉丝提问
